correctness.rationale: The characteristic-five quartic arises from the determinant of gradients of four independent quadrics through the full six-point twisted-cubic configuration. Independent SymPy algebra verified det(gradient q)=2f and on a=1 and d=1 the Jacobian Groebner ideals are (b-d^3,c-d^2,d^5-d) and (a-c^3,b-c^2,c^5-c); complementary a=d=0 has no node, yielding six reduced rational nodes, with nondegenerate Hessians in the package. Independently enumerated 156 P^3(F5) points and all 806 rational projective lines: W has exactly 66 rational points, 25 wholly contained F5-lines, and incidence 6 fivefold, 60 double, union covering W(F5). Six F5 points per line and quartic degree prove actual line containment. Independent F25 arithmetic found W(F25)=1026 and genus-two C(F25)=6, hence U(F25)=460. For every extension degree the proof invokes the classical odd-characteristic Weddle/Kummer isomorphism of minimal K3 resolutions over F5, with 16 versus 6 rational exceptional P1 replacing nodes; genus-2 Weil L=(1-5T^2)^2 then yields W_n and U_n=Q^2-13Q+4(-1)^n Q+60. Exact zeta follows from exponential generating series. Independent finite checks alone cannot justify infinite-degree zeta or the descent of the classical correspondence; that named geometry theorem remains essential.
